apps.localizedDescription:
Runs the retail Steam build of ULTRAKILL on iOS. Instead of rebuilding the game from a decompiled project, it takes the game's own data and runs it in an IL2CPP player built with the same Unity version (2022.3.29f1):

• tools/convert_data.py – converts the Windows data for iOS: every DX11 shader is translated to Metal with Unity's HLSLcc (tools/hlslcc_cli), and every file is re-tagged as an iOS build.
• tools/package_ipa.py – merges the shell IPA and the converted data into ULTRAKILL.ipa.

one-time: build the HLSLcc translator (Visual Studio 2022 + CMake):

python tools/convert_data.py --game "C:/Program Files (x86)/Steam/steamapps/common/ULTRAKILL" --out work.
